definition.simple: Digging up and mixing the soil to make it soft and airy so plant roots can grow easily.
definition.academic: The agricultural preparation of soil by mechanical agitation of various types, such as digging, stirring, and overturning.

examples: A farmer driving a tractor with a cultivator attached to break up hard dirt in a field.
Using a hand shovel to turn over the soil in a small backyard garden.

common_misconceptions: Tilling is only needed to remove weeds.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student what happens when they try to push their finger into concrete vs a sandbox.
